correctness.rationale: For every real weight vector, the product threshold is exactly \(\|w\|_\infty\) by a Bloch-vector Cauchy--Schwarz upper bound with an explicit Pauli-eigenstate saturator. Odd \(n\) makes the three full Pauli strings pairwise anticommuting, so the weighted operator norm is exactly \(\|w\|_2\). The source's trace-norm argument followed by quantum Pinsker therefore gives the one-weight inequality, and standard support-function duality evaluates its supremum as Euclidean distance to the \(\ell_1\) unit ball. The depolarizing consequence follows from exact scalar decay of every full parity string. The proof covers all odd \(n\ge3\); finite checker output is corroborative only.
